Hitmonchan

Fighting

Kanto · Generation 1

Hitmonchan is a Fighting-type Punching Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.4 m tall and weighs 50.2 kg. It evolves from Tyrogue. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (110), with a base stat total of 455.
